_notes: Resumable top-player board pipeline (2026-09-26). The first run spent 5.3 h of its 11 h
extracting the 971k-sample clone set, 2 h on the trunk, finished the board PPO and ran out
before the no-board PPO and the eval. Every step now skips when its output already exists
(the previous run's checkpoints are mounted from the kaggriculture-checkpoints dataset and
copied into out/), PPO steps continue from last.pt with the remaining iterations, the eval
runs whatever arms exist, and a step that cannot fit the remaining budget is skipped so the
eval at the end always gets its hour. Push checkpoints after each run with
tools/kaggle_job/push_checkpoints.sh; extraction only re-runs when bc.pt is missing.

2026-09-26 run 3: the goose_target head changed from [0,8,16,24,32] to [0,4,6,10,16], which invalidates every stored `choices` index, so the clone set and both readouts are rebuilt; only the TRUNK is reused (it regresses margin and is head-independent). The checkpoints dataset for this run carries the trunk ONLY -- shipping the old bc_*.pt or the finished PPO run dirs would make every step skip itself.

Budget for run 3: a full rebuild (extraction ~5.3h at 16,188 sessions) plus both readouts, both PPO arms and the eval overruns the 11h cap, so extraction is capped at --n 8000 (~2.7h). The local 11,350-session build actually cloned BETTER than the kernel's 16,188 (exact-plan 80.7% vs 73.4%), so fewer top-band sessions is not obviously worse. Expected: 0.1 index + 2.7 extract + 0.7 BC + 2.7 PPO board + 2.2 PPO control + 1.5 eval = 9.9h.

steps.cmd: KAGG_BOARD=1 KAGG_BOARD_ARM=T_crop_103 KAGG_MAX_QUADRANTS=3 KAGG_THREADS=1 {python} -u rl/train.py --resume {out}/bc_board/bc.pt --bc-games 0 --seed 1234 --vary-worlds --iters 20 --episodes 64 --procs {procs} --patience 99 --plateau-cool 1.0 --reward win --eval-per-bin 8 --board --trunk-init {out}/trunk_margin_top.pt --run {out}/top_board_s1234

KAGG_BOARD=1 KAGG_BOARD_ARM=T_crop_103 KAGG_MAX_QUADRANTS=3 KAGG_THREADS=1 {python} -u rl/session_eval.py --arm top_board_s1234={out}/top_board_s1234/eval.json --arm top_control_s1234={out}/top_control_s1234/eval.json --arm champ_h8=bundle:arena/agents/champ-h8/main.py --arm dev_champion=dev:champion --baseline champ_h8 --per-bin 50 --procs {procs} --out {out}/session_eval.json 2>&1 | tee {out}/session_eval.log
